long_biography.plain_text:
Ning entered the Pacto group in 2002, years after the Indonesian travel business had been established by the Hasyim Ning family. With postgraduate training in finance and later conference-management credentials, she moved through senior roles in the group's destination and events companies. The travel trade generally knows her as Raty Ning, while official company-linked records use her full name.

She became vice president director of Pacto Convex, the convention-organising arm, and president director of Pacto DMC. In those roles, she promoted professional management and credited growth to the board, managers and staff rather than to family members alone. Recent industry coverage continues to identify her as the DMC's president director. The Ning family holds most Pacto shares, but Ning's exact individual interest is undisclosed. Her position therefore combines family shareholding with active operation instead of founding the group or acting only as a passive heir. Her career and ownership remain centred on travel and tourism. Pacto's revenue, contracts, offices and brand value belong to its companies, and family-wide shares cannot be assigned solely to her.
